scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @brewform/api run dev & pnpm --filter @brewform/web run dev
scripts.check: pnpm --filter @brewform/api run check && pnpm --filter @brewform/web run check && pnpm --filter @brewform/db run check && pnpm --filter @brewform/shared run check
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @brewform/api run build && pnpm --filter @brewform/web run build && pnpm --filter @brewform/shared run build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @brewform/api run lint && pnpm --filter @brewform/web run lint && pnpm --filter @brewform/db run lint && pnpm --filter @brewform/shared run lint
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @brewform/api run test && pnpm --filter @brewform/shared run test && pnpm --filter @brewform/db run test && pnpm --filter @brewform/web run test
scripts.test-coverage: pnpm --filter @brewform/api run test -- --coverage && pnpm --filter @brewform/shared run test -- --coverage && pnpm --filter @brewform/db run test -- --coverage && pnpm --filter @brewform/web run test -- --coverage
scripts.coverage-report: pnpm --filter @brewform/api run test -- --coverage --coverage.reporter=text && pnpm --filter @brewform/shared run test -- --coverage --coverage.reporter=text && pnpm --filter @brewform/db run test -- --coverage --coverage.reporter=text && pnpm --filter @brewform/web run test -- --coverage --coverage.reporter=text
scripts.ci: pnpm run fmt-check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run check && pnpm run build && pnpm run test-coverage && pnpm run test:db && pnpm --filter @brewform/web run test
